Read its external id from the spoke role's trust policy in the IAM console (the sts:ExternalId condition) — CloudFormation masks the parameter as **** (NoEcho), so it cannot be read back there. An administrator there uploads infra/spoke/launchpad-workspace-role.yaml in the CloudFormation console, or runs `aws cloudformation deploy --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`, with HubRoleArn set to the hub role shown on the left and ExternalId to the value in this form. The stack creates one IAM role and nothing else — one stack per account, deployable in any region, because IAM is global.
create.xaStep2: Make the external id match. It has to be identical here and in that stack's parameter: SUGGEST generates a value for a stack you have not deployed yet, while joining an existing stack means reading its current value from the spoke role's trust policy in the IAM console — CloudFormation masks the parameter as **** (NoEcho).

assistantEval.scopeNote: This plan is private to you until assets are created from it. Creating assets registers a local Dataset, AgentCore evaluators and — for each code evaluator — a separate Lambda with its own role. It never deploys the Agent, runs an evaluation, syncs the Dataset to AWS, enables online evaluation or invokes a model. Every evaluator here is an AgentCore evaluator; a golden test nothing in AgentCore can score is blocked with its reason and stays a manual task.

manual.title: Implement what the proposal left to you
manual.body: The proposal listed these items as manual work — the platform never creates them:

online.title: When the offline scores hold, enable online evaluation
online.body: Online evaluation samples live sessions with the same evaluators — leave the reference-dependent ones off there. Turn it on only once the offline run is stable, and start with a low sampling rate.

recommend.title: Generate AI-recommended improvements
recommend.body: An AI recommendation reads the traces of the run you pick (the newest usable run by default — clean, or one that only lost fewer than half of its sessions to incomplete traces; any of this agent's runs, on any dataset) and proposes a revised system prompt (and tool descriptions) with the prompt optimizer you choose on the run's recommendation card. Review the diff; you can still edit the prompt when accepting, and Launchpad re-publishes the Harness with the final text, so AWS creates a new Harness version (DEFAULT follows it).

recommend.waiting: Available once step 2 has a usable run — its traces seed the recommendation.

blocked.evaluator_error: A run completed partially with evaluator errors (not just missing traces), so it cannot seed a recommendation. Review the errors and run again.
blocked.replay_failed: A run completed partially because the agent never answered some scenarios, so it cannot seed a recommendation. Run again.
blocked.low_coverage: A run completed partially but scored fewer than half of its sessions, so it cannot seed a recommendation. Run again.
blocked.legacy: A run completed partially and predates the failure details. Click “Read failure details” in step 2 — if it only lost traces, the run can seed a recommendation.
blocked.unknown: A run completed partially and the worker gave no reason for the unscored sessions, so it cannot seed a recommendation. Run again.

help.title: Task format
help.note: Stored exactly as skilleval expects it — the evaluation and optimization CLIs read these files with no conversion.

id.text: Required. Names the task work directory, so it must be unique in its split and carry no '/', '\' or '..'.

question.text: Required. The prompt handed to the agent under test.

rubric.text: Required. Pass criteria for the LLM judge — write it as an observable check.

taskType.text: Optional. Groups tasks in the per-type score breakdown; defaults to 'default'.

files.text: Optional. Map of safe relative paths to inline text or uploaded XLSX, PDF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP files, seeded into the task workspace before the run.

judgeMode.text: Optional. 'chat' or 'agentic'. This release runs the chat judge; tasks needing the agentic judge fail closed.

modelProviders.unverifiedHint: At least one capability could not be settled by the probe — verify it and save.
modelProviders.fieldSourceHint: Where this value came from. Saving a change here marks the field manual; probes no longer overwrite it.
modelProviders.manualNote: Every capability you change here becomes manual: a re-probe shows the probed value in its diff but never overwrites a manual field unless you reset it first.
modelProviders.noSecretNote: A key you type here is sent once over TLS, checked against the endpoint, written by the console host to the SSM SecureString above and handed to AgentCore Identity. The console keeps only its last four characters; it is never shown again.

hint.name: Lower-case id, 2–32 chars (a-z, 0-9, -). Launchpad ids get the prefix {{prefix}}; the Identity provider is {{provider}}.
hint.baseUrl: https:// and a public hostname. IP literals, loopback / private / link-local addresses and internal names are refused (the host is resolved before every request). An operator may lock the deployment to listed hosts or deny hosts in config/launchpad.yaml.
hint.modelRegion: Region the Global Bedrock API key is used in.
hint.ssmParameter: SecureString holding the API key, pattern launchpad-<name>-api-key (default {{name}}). Only the name is stored.
hint.probeOnAdd: Runs the connectivity, tool-calling, streaming and parameter probes before the row is saved and pre-fills the capabilities (source: probed).
hint.kindDefault: Blank = the kind default (16384 Bedrock / 8192 OpenAI-compatible).
hint.embeddingDimension: Filled by the probe from the returned vector length; a value that disagrees with the probe is refused.
hint.ssmDerived: Derived from the owner and the provider name (launchpad-user-<id>-<name>-api-key). Only the name is stored; enter the key itself on the card.
hint.apiKey: Sent once on save, stored as an SSM SecureString; only the last four characters are shown afterwards. Probed against the endpoint first — a refused key saves nothing. Optional: you can also enter it later from the card.
hint.apiKeyReplace: A key ending in ****{{last4}} is configured. Leave blank to keep it; type a new one to replace it (probed first).
hint.sharedCredentialLocked: Shared provider: only an administrator may change the endpoint, the SSM parameter or the key. You can change the label, the enabled flag and the models.
hint.hostChangeClearsKey: The Base URL changed: the stored key will be cleared and the provider shows as not configured until you enter a key again. To keep using a key with the new host, type it in the API key field in this same save.
